title: The Anglo-Saxons arrive
blurb: Angles, Saxons and Jutes cross the North Sea and bring the Germanic dialects that become Old English.

title: Christianity returns
blurb: Augustine's mission brings Latin church words: altar, candle, school, monk.

title: The Vikings
blurb: Raids, then settlement. Norse and English mingle across the Danelaw.

title: The Norman Conquest
blurb: William of Normandy takes the throne. For three centuries the rulers of England speak French.

title: The printing press
blurb: William Caxton prints the first books in England, and spelling starts to set.

title: Shakespeare
blurb: The playwright is first recorded using hundreds of words, from bedroom to swagger.

title: Johnson's Dictionary
blurb: Samuel Johnson defines 42,773 words — wittily — and English gets its first great dictionary.

title: The World Wide Web
blurb: A new frontier for coinages: blog, google, emoji, selfie.
